_source: Paper runs: tabular Q-learning, Env-1, 10 seeds, 100k episodes (S_down, C, P, R from the main sweep; S_maint, H_down, H_maint from the four-arm sweep; the lambda=4/6 cells of the latter are bit-identical to the main sweep). Values are per-seed evaluation metrics; arms renamed from the original code names (S->S_down, I->H_maint, I_down->H_down).
